text: Foreign partners receive the right to kupat holim when they receive their A5 visa. We have an article on our website about the options for health insurance while on a B1 visa - note especially the discounted private insurance that can be purchased from Clalit and Meuhedet if you are a member of them. I think all of the options in the article also apply while on a tourist visa: aic.org.il/health-insurance-for-b1-partner-visa-holders/
